limits: First failing validation rule is not proof all later checks pass; all failed calls were short-circuited.

Content concerns are qualitative judgments, not a newly approved numeric quality threshold.
No application source, prompt, routing, model/group data or deployment changes in this sampling turn.
No additional fee-bearing judge-model calls, retries, regeneration, saved library batches or full-site tests.
